compare.title: Comparison
compare.notFinished: Every compared run must be finished.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.l0: bar-based approximation: the order of prices inside a bar is unknown (SL assumed first)
limitations.l1: spread from the bar field or a fixed model, not tick-accurate
limitations.l2: no requotes, partial fills or rejections other than margin
limitations.l3: news gaps and weekend gaps are only seen at the next bar's open
limitations.l4: past results do not predict future results

controls.inactive: Kill switch off: the bot may trade within its limits.

halt.title: Activate the kill switch?
halt.body: The engine stops opening new trades. Open positions stay and are still managed (HALT).

flatten.title: Close every bot position?
flatten.body: The engine activates the kill switch in FLATTEN mode and closes all of the bot's positions on its next cycle. Manual positions are not touched.

close.title: Close {{position}}?
close.body: The engine closes this position at the market on its next cycle.

alerts.title: Opportunity alert settings

threshold.strength: Setup strength says how complete the setup is, not how likely it is to work.
threshold.perList: Each watchlist can set its own threshold on the watchlists page.
